scope: Original vertical-shooter gameplay with a Genshin-inspired fan-art visual theme.

prompts.heroes: Production transparent sprite atlas for a PORTRAIT VERTICAL BULLET-HELL SHOOTER, with three Genshin Impact characters. Exactly 12 full-body sprites in a regular 4 COLUMN x 3 ROW grid; all cells equal, generous transparent margins, no sprite crosses a cell. ROW 1: Ningguang, elegant long silver-white hair, ornate white black and gold dress, amber eyes, floating golden geo gemstones. ROW 2: Keqing, lavender twin-tail hair and violet dress, purple eyes, slim silver sword, electro details. ROW 3: Mona, dark indigo hair, characteristic large purple star-patterned astrologer witch hat and blue-purple outfit with gold motifs, water magic. Anime cel-shaded beautiful recognizable faces, tall graceful adult proportions, vivid jewel palette, clean silhouettes. All characters are floating above the ground in a magical aerial shooter, viewed in a front three-quarter view slightly from above, face looking toward viewer; full body from top of hat/hair to feet must fit in each cell. Each row has the same costume and character size in all four frames. Column 1 calm hover ready pose, column 2 banking slightly LEFT with hair and fabric flowing RIGHT, column 3 banking slightly RIGHT with hair and fabric flowing LEFT, column 4 casting attack with one arm extended and a SMALL elemental glow close to hand. No ground, no shadows, no floor, no characters other than these twelve, no labels, no letters or frame borders. Do NOT create a collage or large portraits. Transparent background with alpha. All sprites cleanly separated, enough space around swords and hats, hair stays inside its own cell. This is character art only; 12 clearly separated sprites in a strict grid, three rows four columns.
prompts.heroPackingRepair: Edit this sprite atlas, preserving the exact three recognizable characters, designs, rendering and twelve pose concepts. REPACK the TWELVE characters into the same strict 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid on a truly TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Keep row 1 Ningguang, row 2 Keqing, row 3 Mona. Critical repair: shrink each entire full-body character and all of her hair, hat, sword, cloth and small effects to fit WITHIN its own grid cell, with at least 22 pixels of completely transparent padding on the left and right of every cell, and clear transparent space between all rows. No neighboring sprites may touch or overlap. Every sword tip, floating gem, hat tip and ribbon must remain completely inside the cell. Preserve complete feet and all twelve poses. Keep consistent character height in every cell of a row. Do not add backgrounds, shadows, text, borders or labels. This is a cuttable production game animation sprite sheet, the frame boundaries must pass through EMPTY TRANSPARENT space. Transparent PNG, same 4 x 3 grid.
prompts.scrollingClouds: Asset type: production vertically scrolling background texture for a portrait anime fantasy BULLET HELL VERTICAL SHOOTER. Portrait 2:3 composition. Strict overhead or very high top-down camera, NOT a horizon landscape and NOT an arena floor. Looking DOWN from the sky at a cloud ocean, floating jade islands, ancient ivory ruins with gold inlays, delicate gardens and aqueduct fragments. Most structures stay in the outer LEFT and RIGHT edges. The central 65% width must stay open quiet desaturated blue-teal cloud layers and soft deep atmospheric space, medium value, low visual detail, where bright enemy bullets are easy to read. No central building, no solid floor across the center. The environment flows vertically from top to bottom with depth: small distant islands far below, larger cropped pale marble terrace corners and blue-green foliage at edges. Luminous polished Genshin Impact-inspired cel-shaded fantasy world, airy turquoise, pearl stone and subdued gold, sunlight from upper left. Elegant, colorful, inviting, beautiful, clean large readable forms, NOT muddy photorealism. Vertical scrolling texture: top and bottom edges should both have similar continuous soft muted teal cloud patterns and NO horizontal border or horizon, so repeating vertically is visually unobtrusive. The playable field must feel like flight through a magical cloud realm. No characters, no monsters, no projectiles, no UI, no text, no watermark. No Japanese shrine, no torii, no lanterns, no city streets.
prompts.enemies: Use case: game-assets. Create a production sprite atlas on a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Wide landscape 3:1 composition, exactly three separate original anime-fantasy monster sprites, one sprite centered inside each equal third. Left: small floating turquoise crystal wisp, faceted bright cyan core enclosed by two small ivory stone fins, an expressive single golden eye, elegant not scary, no legs. Middle: medium hovering ruined stone sentinel with a large amber eye, cream stone armor pieces and turquoise crystal joints, two separated articulated forearms, compact broad body, ancient fantasy technology. Right: imposing winged crystalline guardian boss, floating central dark teal diamond core and six ivory-and-gold segmented stone wings, angular elegant symmetrical silhouette, glowing gold central eye. High three-quarter view, the camera looks down onto them somewhat so they match a high-angle isometric game arena. Luminous polished cel-shaded anime game rendering, clear dark-edged shapes, pearl stone and rich teal facets, crisp gold highlights. All THREE complete silhouettes fully visible with generous TRANSPARENT padding on every side and between subjects, no overlaps across their third of the sheet, no ground shadows, no environment, no labels, no numbers, no particles reaching outside silhouettes, no border. Original designs; consistent lighting from upper left. Sprites intended for a mobile fantasy combat game.

preparation: Alpha component extraction, registered frame crops, WebP compression and a short vertical texture seam blend.
